jsonTools.label: Defined Terms

catalog.title: DEFINED TERMS
catalog.desc: Every defined term with its definition, however it is marked - quoted, bold, italic, underlined or just capitalised. Flags terms defined twice, defined but never used, and used but never defined.
catalog.action: if (window.eli && window.eli.dispatch) window.eli.dispatch('tile', 'app_defined_terms'); else if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Defined Terms not loaded.', 'error');
